description: Shared type definitions for SPEC learning events.

eventId.description: Globally unique event identifier. Format: sha256(userDid + hostLemma + sourceId + encounteredAt). Enables cross-app deduplication.

languageCode.description: ISO 639-1 language code. Defaults to ko for SPEC Korean learning contexts.

difficulty.description: Pre-computed difficulty score (0–10000). Optional — not all events have this set.

register.description: Korean linguistic register of the source content. Affects difficulty and acquisition path. formal_written:书面，正式书面语 (news, academic) formal_speech:正式的会话体 (polite conversation, honorifics) informal_speech:非正式会话体 (casual polite) colloquial:口語体 (strongly colloquial, includes non-standard forms) literary:文学作品语 (novels, poetry)

patternId.description: Unique identifier for the morpheme pattern (e.g. suffix -으려고)

hostLemma.description: The lemma (dictionary form) of the host word containing this morpheme

hostEojeol.description: The full eojeol (space-separated word token) where the morpheme appeared

sourceId.description: Reference to the sentence.read event that this encounter belongs to. Links morpheme encounters to their source sentence for provenance.

encounterCount.description: Total number of encounters of this pattern across all reading

firstEncounteredAt.description: Timestamp of first encounter (persisted across sessions)
